title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
passage:
Every day, university canteens across the country serve millions of meals, and a surprising {{1}} of food ends up in the bin. A recent {{2}} at one university found that students {{3}} away about sixty grams of food per meal on average. Much of it had never been touched: rice left on the plate, vegetables pushed to one side, half a dish that was simply too large.

The reasons are not hard to find. When the {{4}} offers only large dishes at a low price, people tend to take more than they can eat, and busy students are often not {{5}} of how much they leave behind.

Several universities are now trying to {{6}} the problem. Some canteens offer smaller {{7}} at a lower price, so that a light eater is not forced to waste food. Others put up posters and {{8}} students to take {{9}} home in {{10}} boxes. Managers say the results are encouraging: in one canteen, waste fell by almost a third within a single term.

blanks.explain: a surprising amount of 表示数量惊人的，用于不可数名词 food，说明食堂浪费量很大。
此处需要名词作主语，survey 意为调查，与 found 搭配，指一项调查发现了这一数据。
throw away 是固定搭配，意为扔掉，与 food 和 bin 呼应，指学生每餐平均扔掉约六十克食物。
此处需要名词作从句主语，menu 意为菜单；菜单上只有大份菜品且价格便宜，学生就容易取得过多。
be aware of 是固定搭配，意为意识到，说明忙碌的学生往往没注意自己剩下多少食物。
此处需要动词，reduce 意为减少，与 problem 搭配，指高校正努力减少浪费问题。
portion 意为一份饭菜，smaller portions 指分量更小的餐食，价格为 lower，符合语境。
encourage sb. to do sth. 意为鼓励某人做某事，与 put up posters 并列，都是减少浪费的做法。
leftovers 意为剩饭菜，take leftovers home 指把没吃完的饭菜带回家，符合食堂减少浪费的做法。
此处需要形容词修饰 boxes，reusable 意为可重复使用的，与减少垃圾的目标一致。
